moments.author: Milwaukee Brewers
moments.quote: THE WORLD SERIES CHAMPIONSHIP BELONGS TO MILWAUKEE, WISCONSIN!!!!!!!!!!!!
moments.why: Blowing up because the Brewers won their first World Series title in franchise history, a moment resonating with fans nationwide.
moments.url: https://www.neteye.dev/en/trending/us (trending X post quoted by media)

moments.author: William Contreras
moments.quote: It means everything because that's the first time Venezuela guys win the WBC and the World Series.
moments.why: Viral as William Contreras, World Series MVP, ties a cultural milestone for Venezuelan athletes to the Brewers’ victory.

moments.author: CC Sabathia
moments.why: His post caught fire as a succinct rallying cry from a baseball icon to close out the Brewers’ run.
moments.url: Milwaukee Journal Sentinel via AOL coverage

moments.author: Seth McClung
moments.quote: All these people standing top 9th are #Brewers Fans... It’s really crazy the amount of opposing fans are here for a #WorldSeries game.
moments.why: A viral snapshot of opposing fans packed for a Brewers World Series game, symbolizing the team’s cross-regional pull.
moments.url: Milwaukee Journal Sentinel via AOL coverage
